caption: The video showcases a high-angle view of a wooden floor laid out with a starburst of dominoes. Eight colored radial arms—yellow, green, light blue, navy, purple, pink, red and orange—each meet a central yellow disc crowned by a small red piece through a short row of black dominoes, while a vertical black line drops from the center to a horizontal black line crossing the bottom edge. Initially the arrangement appears upright and still. Then the red piece on the disc tilts down, and the black connector dominoes around the center begin to tip. This disturbance spreads outward along each colored row, the inner ends falling first as the line of collapse travels toward the outer tips. The inner segments of all eight arms lie flat while their outer ends remain standing, leaving the radial collapse still underway. The vertical black line and the horizontal black line at the bottom stay upright and unchanged throughout, and the framing of the floor holds steady.
